definitions.content: rounded or approximate value of a characteristic of a measuring instrument that provides a guide to its use

examples.content: stem:[100 "unitsml(Ohm)"] as the value marked on a standard resistor;
stem:[1 "unitsml(L)"] as the value marked on a single-mark volumetric flask;
stem:[0.1 "unitsml(mol/L)"] as the amount-of-substance concentration of a solution of hydrogen chloride, HCl;
stem:[25 "unitsml(degC)"] as the set point of a thermostatically controlled bath.

definitions.content: valeur arrondie ou approximative d'une caractéristique d'un instrument de mesure qui sert de guide pour son utilisation

examples.content: la valeur stem:[100 "unitsml(Ohm)"] sur une résistance étalon;
la valeur stem:[1 "unitsml(L)"] marquée sur une fiole jaugée à un trait;
la valeur stem:[0.1 "unitsml(mol/L)"] de la concentration en quantité de matière d'une solution d'acide chlorhydrique, HCl;
la valeur stem:[25 "unitsml(degC)"] du point de consigne d'un bain thermostatique.
